πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολέσιν: πολύς — much, many; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic (= Attic πολλοῖς)
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause
πορφυρέην: πορφύρεος — purple, dark-gleaming; adj., fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic πορφυρᾶν)
πορφύρεος: πορφύρεος — purple, dark, dusky; masc. nom. sg., epithet of death
πρηνέες: πρηνής — headlong, face down; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic πρηνεῖς)
πρηνὴς: πρηνής — face down, headlong; masc. nom. sg.
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρυμνὸν: πρυμνός — hindmost, at the end or base; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’at the base’
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of’ (πρόσθεν ἕθεν ’in front of him’)
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸ: πρό — before, forth; adv. or preverb, in tmesis (πρὸ … ἧκε = προῆκε ’sent forth’); also prep. + gen. · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, in defence of’ (πρὸ γυναικῶν ’for the wives’) · also prep. following its word, after a locative in -θι: ’before’ (Ἰλιόθι πρό ’before Ilios’) · also adv. in διὰ πρό, ’right through’ (διὰ πρὸ … ἐλάσσαι ’drive right through’)
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’
πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., with χθών · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπαλξις: ’the whole (of it)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἴλιος: ’all (of Ilios)’
σκότος: σκότος — darkness; masc. nom. sg., the dark of death
στέρνον: στέρνον — chest, breast; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect
στόμα: στόμα — mouth, face; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’mouth’ (κεφαλὴ στόμα τε ῥῖνές τε ’head and mouth and nostrils’) · also the point of a weapon: ’tip’ (κατὰ στόμα … χαλκῷ ’at the tip, with bronze’)
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
σφεδανὸν: σφεδανός — violent, impetuous; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’furiously’
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τάφρος: τάφρος — ditch, trench; fem. nom. sg.
τάφρῳ: τάφρος — ditch, trench; fem. dat. sg.
τανύοντο: τανύω — stretch, strain; impf. 3 pl. mid./pass., unaugmented: ’were stretched out’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων)
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρῳαὶ: Τρῳάς — Trojan woman; fem. nom. pl., Ionic Τρῳαί
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάλον: φάλος — part of a helmet, usually taken as the ridge that carried the plume; the sense is not certain; masc. acc. sg.
φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
φυλεΐδης: Φυλεΐδης — son of Phyleus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
φόβοιο: φόβος — flight, panic; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), objective gen. after μήστωρε: ’of flight’
φόβος: Φόβος — Terror, Rout personified (cf. φόβος ’flight, fear’); masc. nom. sg. · also φόβος — flight, fear (not personified); masc. nom. sg.: ’terror’ (φόβος ἔλλαβε πάντας ’terror seized all’)
φῶτες: φώς — man, hero; masc. nom. pl. (φώς, φωτός): ’men’
χάλκεον: χάλκεος — of bronze; neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦν) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔγχος: ’of bronze’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’of bronze’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕπνον: ’of bronze’ (χάλκεον ὕπνον ’a bronze sleep’)
χέει: χέω — pour, shed, scatter; pres. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic χεῖ)
χίμαιραν: Χίμαιρα — the Chimaera, a fire-breathing monster (lit. she-goat); fem. acc. sg.
χαλκοκορυστῇ: χαλκοκορυστής — armed in bronze; masc. dat. sg., epithet
χαλκὸν: χαλκός — bronze; masc. acc. sg.: ’the bronze’ (i.e. armour) · also the bronze weapon, the spear-point: ’the bronze’ (χαλκὸν ἀνασχέσθαι ’to withstand the bronze’)
χθὼν: χθών — earth, ground; fem. nom. sg.
χολωθεὶς: χολόω — anger; pass. ’be angered’ (+ dat.); aor. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.
ἀέκοντας: ἀέκων — unwilling; masc. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἄκων), agreeing with ἵππους · also masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἑταίρους: ’unwilling’
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’) · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition (ἀγλαὰ τέκνα ’splendid children’)
ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
ἀκοντίσσαι: ἀκοντίζω — hurl a javelin, cast; aor. inf. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἀκοντίσαι), + gen. of the target: ’to cast at’
ἀκωκὴ: ἀκωκή — point, edge; fem. nom. sg.
ἀκόντων: ἄκων — javelin, dart; masc. gen. pl.
ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valour, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg.
ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl., after πλησίον: ’one another’ · also gen. pl., possessive, dependent on a noun: ’one another’s’ (ἀλλήλων … στήθεσσι ’one another’s chests’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἀντίον: ’one another’ (ἀντίον ἀλλήλων ’face to face with one another’) · also gen. pl. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἰθυνομένων ’as they aimed at one another’) · also gen. pl. as object of ἐφικνέομαι: ’of one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἐφίκοντο ’got hold of one another’)
ἀμαιμακέτην: ἀμαιμάκετος — of unknown meaning, guessed ’huge’ or ’irresistible’; fem. acc. sg., epithet of the Chimaera
ἀμφεκάλυψεν: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round about, envelop; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (= ἀμφεκάλυψε), ν-movable: ’enveloped’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνάκτων: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the lords’
ἀνάλκιδα: ἄναλκις — without strength, unwarlike, cowardly; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σε: ’a coward’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἐμέ: ’(me) without might’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with φύζαν: ’(panic) without might’
ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀντίθεος: ἀντίθεος — godlike; masc. nom. sg., general epithet of heroes
ἀντίλοχος: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
ἀντικρὺ: ἀντικρύ — straight through, right through; adv. (epic, = ἀντικρύς) · also of fighting, ’head-on, face to face’ (ἀντικρὺ μάχεσθαι ’to fight head-on’)
ἀντιλόχῳ: Ἀντίλοχος — Antilochus, son of Nestor; masc. dat. sg.
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀρήϊος: ἀρήϊος — of Ares, warlike; masc. nom. sg.
ἀσπίδι: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by his shield’ · also fem. dat. sg. after ὑπό: ’under the shield’ (ὑπ’ ἀσπίδι)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφάμαρτεν: ἀφαμαρτάνω — miss, fail to hit (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἀφήμαρτε), ν-movable: ’missed’
ἀφραδίῃσι: ἀφραδίη — folly, thoughtlessness; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις): ’through folly’
ἀχλύς: ἀχλύς — mist, dimness, haze; fem. nom. sg.
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ
ἄλκιμος: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, valiant, brave (from ἀλκή); masc. nom. sg.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄνδρεσσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἀνδράσι)
ἄξαντ: ἄγνυμι — break; aor. part. act. masc. dual nom., elided (ἄξαντ’ = ἄξαντε): ’having broken’
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄραξε: ἀράσσω — strike, dash, smash; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤραξε): ’smashed’
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄχρις: ἄχρις — right up to the end, utterly; adv.
ἄψορρον: ἄψορρος — backward, back again; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’back’
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐπιβησόμενον: ἐπιβαίνω — mount, step upon (+ gen.); fut. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’about to mount’
ἐπορούσας: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’rushing on’
ἐπόρουσε: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπώρουσε)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρίηρας: ἐρίηρος — traditionally ’trusty’, exact sense uncertain (of companions); masc. acc. pl.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλοὶ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; adj., masc. nom. pl.
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’)
ἐχούσας: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. fem. acc. pl.: ’holding’
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἑτεραλκέα: ἑτεραλκής — turning the strength to the other side (victory now to one, now to the other); sense disputed; fem. acc. sg., epic -έα (= Attic -ῆ) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with δῆμον: ’tipping the balance’
ἔγχεος: ἔγχος — spear; neut. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἔγχους)
ἔγχεσι: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. pl. (epic also ἔγχεσσι)
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔδυ: δύω — go in, sink down; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist ἔδυ): ’went down into’
ἔλασσε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἤλασε): ’drove’
ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
ἔσχεθε: ἔχω — hold, hold back; aor. 3 sg. act., epic by-form of σχέθω (= Attic ἔσχε)
ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’)
ἕλεν: αἱρέω — take, seize; in battle, kill; aor. 2 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic εἷλεν)
ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I took away’
ἕπετο: ἕπομαι — follow; impf. 3 sg. mid./dep., unaugmented (= εἵπετο): ’followed’
ἡγεμόνες: ἡγεμών — leader, commander; masc. nom. pl.
ἡγεμόνων: ἡγεμών — leader, guide; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the leaders’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἤλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive; also strike, deal a blow; aor. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented ἔλασεν): ’drove, struck’ · also ’beat out, hammer (metal)’: aor. 3 sg., ’hammered’
ἤματ: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., elided (ἤματ’ = ἤματα), acc. of duration: ’for (twenty) days’
ἤριπε: ἐρείπω — throw down; in the intransitive aor. ἤριπον, fall headlong, crash down; aor. 3 sg.: ’fell headlong’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἰαχή: ἰαχή — cry, shout, war-cry; fem. nom. sg.
ἰαχῇ: ἰαχή — cry, shout; fem. dat. sg.
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδρείῃ: ἰδρείη — skill, knowledge, cunning; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by skill’
ἰδόντες: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl., unaugmented: ’having seen’
ἱέμενοι: ἵεμαι — strain toward, long for, be eager; pres. part. mid./dep. masc. nom. pl., + gen.: ’making for’
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε): ’saw’
ἵετ: ἵεμαι (mid. of ἵημι) — hasten, be eager, long (+ inf.); elided ἵετ’, pres. 3 sg. mid. (= ἵεται; or impf. ἵετο): ’is eager’
ἵετο: ἵεμαι — hasten, be eager (+ dat./inf.); impf. 3 sg. mid. (middle of ἵημι ’send’)
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀξυόεντι: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. dat. sg., epic -όεντι, agreeing with ἔγχεϊ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί: ’sharp’ (δουρὶ … ὀξυόεντι ’with a sharp spear’)
ὀπωρινῷ: ὀπωρινός — of late summer, of the season of ripening fruit (ὀπώρη); masc. dat. sg., with ἀστέρι
ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὀστέον: ὀστέον — bone; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ὀστοῦν)
ὀφθαλμῶν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. gen. pl., after ἀπό: ’from the eyes’ · also masc. gen. pl. after κατά: ’down over the eyes’ (κατ’ ὀφθαλμῶν)
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὀϊλιάδης: Ὀϊλιάδης — son of Oileus (patronymic), the lesser Ajax; masc. nom. sg.
ὁμοκλήσας: ὁμοκλέω (ὁμοκλάω) — shout at, rebuke, call out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’shouting’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄρεσσι: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ὄρεσι)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπέρθορον: ὑπερθρῴσκω — leap over; 2nd aor. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.): ’I leapt over’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’)
ὑσμίνης: ὑσμίνη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg.
ὠκέες: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὠκύποδες: ὠκύπους — swift-footed; masc. nom. pl., agreeing with ἵπποι
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’)
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέοντες: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’flowing’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥυμῷ: ῥυμός — chariot pole; masc. dat. sg.
ῥῆξεν: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, unaugmented (= ἔρρηξε): ’broke’
